claim_updates.reason: RETAINED AT EXPERIMENTAL; the registry ceiling is already EXPERIMENTAL (research/claims/registry.json line 6, sha256 3511a7885c0ece903eff3cc2b57592a3291e000fecf28f930786fc038a29894b, owner_lanes graph+product, next_gate 'learn on resource A, succeed on never-observed B against cold/replay/retrieval baselines'). This is a no-ceiling-change retention, not a downgrade and not an advance. NOT ADVANCED TO VALIDATED even though audit.json.status=PASS, because (a) audit.json.producer_claim_supported=false and producer_claim_supported=false means the producer's claimed ceiling is not justified as written; (b) the frozen PRIMARY decision clause failed (derived/decision_rule_eval.json primary.pass=false; advantage_vs_cold and advantage_vs_retrieval both -0.20, thresholds >0.15), so no frozen gate passed; and (c) the registered next_gate 'succeed on never-observed B against cold/replay/retrieval baselines' is not met on this design. NOT DOWNGRADED to REJECTED/BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID, on four grounds grounded in the packet: (1) the transaction completed validly (result.json.status=COMPLETE, outcome=FALSIFIES maps to a valid scientific negative per prereg.md section 7, not infrastructure failure); (2) SUBSTRATE_VALIDITY, CAUSAL_ATTRIBUTION, ACCOUNTING_HONESTY and KNOWN-NEGATIVE all PASS (derived/decision_rule_eval.json), so the measurement is valid; (3) the failing PRIMARY margin has ZERO DYNAMIC RANGE for any correct system on this substrate: cold (B-COLD-RE-DERIVE) and retrieval (B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED) both achieve success_rate=1.0 (result.json.metrics; report.md 'Cold and retrieval are strong baselines here ... legitimately achieve 1.0'), so the maximum attainable advantage over them is 0.0 and the >0.15 threshold is unreachable even if the treatment reached 1.0; the failure is therefore not an identifying falsification of the architecture (audit.json validity_findings[1] 'decision_rule_margin_demand' severity=design; audit.json unresolved U-DECISION_RULE_CALIBRATION); (4) the treatment's own 0.80 is bounded by one conservative support regex `^type\-00[0-9]{1}$` inferred from 5 examples that rejects the adjacent '-010' form (induced_mechanisms.json; task_trajectories.jsonl T-SPIDER-PARAM item-010/user-010/order-010), a genuine but single-point support-generalization ceiling of the current implementation (result.json validity_notes[0]; audit.json validity_findings[0]; unresolved U-SUPPORT-GENERALIZATION), not an execute-stage or architecture failure. WHAT IS NOW ESTABLISHED AT THE AUDITED CEILING (all four post/pre controls and audit PASS): the committed kernel's parameterized round trip (distill_parameterized -> resolve -> execute) is LIVE and causally attributable on a real credential-free localhost stdlib-HTTP substrate outside SYNTH-INDUCTION-BANK-v1 (T-SPIDER-PARAM 12/15 held-out identifiers EXECUTABLE and HTTP-executed; PC-EXACT-REPLAY 15/15 on training; B-LITERAL-KERNEL 0/15 because confidence 0.5 < min_confidence 0.8), the treatment arm is separable by mechanism architecture, accounting is honest (model_calls=0 and model_tokens=0 for all arms, no injected counter events, retrieval_calls treatment=1/cold=0/retrieval=3 per task, verification_calls fire on execution; accounting_counters.jsonl; arm_metrics.json), and known negatives are refused 15/15 with bound_action=null plus null-control unseen-type 5/5 (known_negatives.jsonl; null_control_unseen_type.jsonl). Caveat carried: the 'wrong_intent' refusals share the generic reason string 'no applicable validated mechanism' with the null-type control and are categorized as wrong_intent only by the harness mapping, so distinct intent-mismatch detection is not independently demonstrated. C-LLM-INHERIT is untouched and remains HYPOTHESIS: zero model calls/tokens and zero real-LLM arms ran.

reason: The independent audit is PASS (audit.json.status=PASS) with recomputed_metrics matching the producer field-for-field, and it independently confirms substrate validity, causal attribution, accounting honesty and known-negative detection, while explicitly declining to support the producer's claimed ceiling (audit.json.producer_claim_supported=false, required_fixes=[]). I inspected the raw evidence directly rather than adopting the summaries: task_trajectories.jsonl shows T-SPIDER-PARAM 12/15 with the only three failures at item-010/user-010/order-010 (resolution_status=EXPLORE, reason 'parameter ... outside inferred support'); B-COLD-RE-DERIVE 15/15; B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED 15/15; PC-EXACT-REPLAY 15/15; B-LITERAL-KERNEL 0/15. induced_mechanisms.json shows the inferred support `^type\-00[0-9]{1}$` from five training examples. accounting_counters.jsonl shows model_calls/model_tokens 0 and per-task retrieval/verification increments on real execution. known_negatives.jsonl shows 15/15 refusals with bound_action=null; null_control_unseen_type.jsonl shows 5/5. derived/decision_rule_eval.json shows KNOWN-NEGATIVE, ACCOUNTING_HONESTY, CAUSAL_ATTRIBUTION and SUBSTRATE_VALIDITY all pass and PRIMARY fail (advantage vs cold and vs retrieval both -0.20 against the frozen >0.15 threshold), producing outcome=FALSIFIES. The Director accepts the producer's FALSIFIES as the correct mapping of the frozen rule but refuses the tempting over-read that this falsifies parameterized inheritance: the PRIMARY margin has no dynamic range because both comparators are at the 1.0 ceiling, so no correct system can clear it (the treatment would still show advantage 0.0 even with perfect support inference). The measurement is a valid scientific negative for the frozen design, not an architecture rejection and not a MEASUREMENT_INVALID outcome. The correct bounded state is therefore C-PARAM-INHERIT RETAINED at EXPERIMENTAL with the real-substrate liveness/separation/accounting findings established at the audit ceiling and two explicit unresolved kernel/design questions (U-SUPPORT-GENERALIZATION, U-DECISION_RULE_CALIBRATION). Product promotion is refused because no frozen gate passed and spec.json forbids it. Continue is false because the next pulling step - the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark on a non-ceiling task bank - requires a programmatic model credential the factory does not control plus a NEW Global Research Director mandate, and this lane must not self-dispatch; the credential-free liveness prerequisite that motivated this experiment is now satisfied. Frozen inputs verified byte-identical to freeze.json hashes before writing this verdict.
